text:
maria: Heads up — staging perf p99 jumped from 220ms -> 1.1s after we onboarded model v3.2 this morning. Looks like a small subset of requests are taking the slow kernel path. :eyes:

jon: Which kernel? Is this kernel selection tie-break behavior we saw last quarter?

maria: CI alert from perf-suite: https://internal.redwood/dashboard/ci/perf/2109876 — failing tests: batch_latency_p99. ci-bot posted details below.

ci-bot: [perf-suite] Regression detected on branch staging: batch_latency_p99 increased by 4.8x. Suspected commits: range 7a3c..f9b2. See run: https://ci/runs/98765

alex: I've seen stragglers before when padding dist changes. Any KV-cache evictions in traces?

maria: I pulled profiler traces. Short excerpt:
```text
pid=412 kselect=throughput kernel=nv_fast
seq_len=8 -> routed to kernel nv_fast
seq_len=64 -> tie-break score flipped -> fallback kernel nv_safe
kv_cache_hits=0.87
latency_ms: 120 -> 1120 (on fallback kernel)
```
looks like tie-break scoring uses weighted mean seq_len; new tokenizer increases variance.

lynn: I started a local bisect. First bad commit is f1c2d3 — it tweaked batching heuristic: "prefer stability_score over throughput when stddev>30". That change was meant for long convo workloads but regresses short-span bursts.

jon: Can you confirm with a repro? Maybe run the small-batch smoke in staging with pinned model v3.2.

maria: Ran repro: `scripts/repro_batch_stragglers.sh --model v3.2 --seed 42` — reproduces 4.6x p99. I attached flamegraph to the ticket. (link)

alex: Quick mitigation: lower stddev threshold or prefer throughput for sequences <16. That's a one-line change in batch_scheduler.cc

lynn: I can push a hotfix PR: #4872. Will add test that covers seq_len var change.

maria: Rollout hold on v3.2 in staging and dedicated. Deploy-bot, please pause.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused for model v3.2 (reason: p99 batch stragglers). Triggering rollback on canary clusters.

jon: Also check KV cache warmup settings — when kernels switch we lose KV locality and evict primes.

maria: Good catch. I'll add a KV warmup to the hotfix too (opt-in for short-lived kernels).

alex: If hotfix lands, let's run the same CI perf suite and shadow traffic for 30m before unpausing. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Rerun requested: perf-suite triggered for PR #4872. Link: https://ci/runs/98766

maria: Assigned action items: lynn->PR, alex->quick perf run + prod shadow script, jon->monitor KV evictions dashboard. I'll follow up with postmortem template once fixed. :v:
